steps.what: List the pretreatment and storm water requirements on file.
Analyze and implement the pollution prevention program.
Record the approved program the inspector maintains.

tasks.design: Pretreatment, pollution prevention, and storm water requirements already in {DOCS} are listed before the inspector works. The inspector analyzes what the local rules require and implements the approved program. A requirement with no id is not listed. The list does not implement the program.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program files mixed several years of requirements, and the inspector re-read them for each site.
tasks.enabler_now: Requirements already given an id can be listed for the program.
tasks.still_hard: A local rule that is not in the file, and a program the list does not know how to run.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a listed requirement that does not fit this site’s runoff.
tasks.altitude: The known requirements are listed. The inspector still analyzes and implements the program. An unlisted rule is not treated as part of it.

reach.task: List the requirements already adopted and still carry out the program.
reach.learn: The list can be prepared. The implementation stays here.

evidence.claim: Requirements already in the program file can be listed. The list cannot analyze the site or implement the program.

A field compare does not register a product, approve a discharge, or change a procedure. The inspector decides, including that no action is taken. EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with a legal effect.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.
Fields: Program id and requirement id, produced by the program file. A requirement with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the program file the organisation already keeps.
unknowns: Which programs are approved this year.
Who maintains the program besides the inspector.
research_questions: What share of requirements already have an id?
Which implementations need a site visit?

already_counted.description: The inspector still analyzes and implements the program.
The inspector still records the approved program.

incremental.description: The inspector adds a local requirement the file did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the list of requirements already in the file. It disappears when a requirement has no id and the inspector finds the text. Analyzing and implementing the program stay with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Compare label fields with the regulatory requirements.
Evaluate whether the label information is accurate.
Record the conformance finding on that label.

tasks.design: Named label fields are compared in {DOCS} with the regulatory requirement ids. The inspector evaluates whether the label information is accurate and records the conformance finding. A label field with no requirement id is not compared. The compare does not pass the label.
tasks.previous_blocker: Labels were checked against a printed list that did not match the current requirement.
tasks.enabler_now: A named field can be compared with the requirement id before the inspector looks at the product.
tasks.still_hard: A claim on the label that is not a named field, and a true field on the wrong product.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a complete field set that describes a different product.
tasks.altitude: Named fields are compared before the product is in hand. The inspector still evaluates accuracy and conformance. An unnamed claim is not passed by the compare.

reach.task: Compare a label field with a requirement id and still judge the product.
reach.learn: The field compare can run. The accuracy judgement stays here.

evidence.claim: A named label field can be compared with a requirement id. The compare cannot judge that the label is accurate.

A field compare does not register a product, approve a discharge, or change a procedure. The inspector decides, including that no action is taken. EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with a legal effect.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.

Fields: Label id, field id, and requirement id, produced by the label record and the requirement list. A field with no requirement id is not compared. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the requirement list the organisation already keeps.
unknowns: Who may pass a label besides the inspector.
research_questions: What share of labels have named fields?
Which claims are always read on the product?

already_counted.description: The inspector still evaluates whether the label is accurate.
The inspector still records the conformance finding.

incremental.description: The inspector reads a claim the field list did not name.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is comparing named label fields with requirement ids. It disappears when a field has no requirement id and the inspector reads the label. The accuracy judgement stays with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer service charge and capacity fee questions.

steps.what: Answer a service charge question from a published rate id.
Respond to the other inquiries or refer them.
Review a reply about capacity fees before it is sent.

tasks.design: A question is answered from the {ERP} only when it matches a published service charge or capacity fee id. Other inquiries stay with the inspector, who responds or refers them to a supervisor. A question with no rate id is not answered by the desk. The desk does not invent a fee.
tasks.previous_blocker: Charge questions were answered from a personal note of last year’s rates.
tasks.enabler_now: A published rate id can answer the matching question.
tasks.still_hard: A question that is not on the rate table, and a fee a supervisor must set.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can tell that a matching rate is not the fee this customer should be quoted.
tasks.altitude: Published rates answer the questions that match them. The inspector still handles the rest and still refers what a supervisor must decide. No fee is invented.

reach.role: Tax Examiners and Collectors, and Revenue Agents
reach.task: Answer from a published rate and refer the case the rate does not cover.
reach.learn: The rate can be quoted. The unmatched question stays here.

evidence.claim: A question that matches a published rate id can be answered from that rate. A question with no rate id cannot be answered by a lookup.
A charge is calculated only from a volume id and a published rate id. A missing rate stops the line. The desk does not invent a fee.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.

Fields: Question id and rate id, produced by the published rate table. A question with no rate id is not answered by the desk. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the rate table the billing system already keeps.
unknowns: Which questions are in the published table.
research_questions: What share of questions match a published rate id?
Which replies must be reviewed before they are sent?

already_counted.description: The inspector still answers or refers the questions the table does not cover.
The inspector still reviews a capacity fee reply.

incremental.description: The inspector corrects a reply that quoted a retired rate.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is answering a question that matches a published rate id. It disappears when the question has no rate id and the inspector answers or refers it. Unmatched questions stay with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate volumes and recommend a classification.

steps.what: Calculate discharge volumes from stored allowances and limits.
Recommend the wastewater classification from those figures.
Complete the documentation the inspector accepts.

tasks.design: Discharge volumes are calculated in the {ERP} only when the allowance, the limit, and the volume id are already stored. The inspector recommends the wastewater strength classification and completes the documentation. A missing id stops the line. The arithmetic does not make the recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Volumes were figured on a pad from allowances that belonged to another site.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored allowances and limits can be calculated before the inspector recommends.
tasks.still_hard: A production figure the store does not hold, and a classification the arithmetic does not choose.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a correct volume that should not take the usual classification.
tasks.altitude: Known volumes are calculated. The inspector still recommends the classification and still completes the documentation. A missing id is not given a number.

reach.task: Calculate from stored inputs and still leave the recommendation to the person who knows the case.
reach.learn: The arithmetic can be prepared. The classification stays here.

evidence.claim: A volume can be calculated from an allowance and a limit already stored. The calculation cannot recommend the classification.
A charge is calculated only from a volume id and a published rate id. A missing rate stops the line. The desk does not invent a fee.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.

Fields: Volume id, allowance id, and limit id, produced by the discharge record. A line with a missing id is not calculated. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the allowances and limits the organisation already stores.
unknowns: Which limit set applies to a site.
Who accepts a classification besides the inspector.
research_questions: What share of lines have all three ids?

already_counted.description: The inspector still recommends the classification.
The inspector still completes the documentation.

incremental.description: The inspector supplies a volume the store did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the calculation where the allowance, the limit, and the volume id are already stored. It disappears when an id is missing and the inspector calculates by hand. The recommendation stays with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The inspector still implements the program, still judges the label, and still makes the recommendation. A requirement id, a published charge, and a stored volume can be ready before that work.
reach: Tax examiners calculate from a stored base and a published rate, and this job learns a missing rate stops the line.
Regulatory affairs specialists check a label against a requirement id, and this job learns the check is not the conformance decision.
skills_to_grow: Refuse a charge answer that has no published rate id.
Keep the program implementation and the recommendation with the inspector.
role.ambitious_version: Requirement lists and published rates are ready before the inspector decides, and a missing id still stops the line.
